unit.why: A single anecdote: the Maggid of Kozhenitz, still poor and unknown, visits R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev, who borrows his fur coat while escorting him in the cold, and afterwards the Maggid becomes famous and prosperous.

stories.start_quote: עוד שמעתי ממנו שסיפר שטרם שנתפרסם
stories.summary_en: Before he became famous, the poor Maggid of Kozhenitz complained of his poverty to R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev in Zelichov. While escorting him out in bitter cold, R. Levi Yitzhak borrowed the Maggid's fur coat until the Maggid nearly froze, then returned it saying in Yiddish 'Reb Yisraelkin, now be warm'. From then on the Maggid became famous and prospered.

quotes: ונסע להרה״ק ז"ל מבארדיטשוב שהי' אז משכנו
tags.why: The Maggid travels to the Berditchever to bring his plea

quotes: ר׳ ישראלכין לאז אייך שוין זיין ווארם
tags.why: The tsaddik's act changes another person's fortune
